groups.label: Living at the plot for now, with Pat left missing him
groups.description: A day with a shape at a place that knows him, winter kept from mind, and Pat missing him at home

groups.label: No longer ashamed, of dead beans or of sitting down

quoted.T2:39:0: "When I come in now, Frank looks up and says, here he is. … But it's near enough. It's near enough for me. I'll take here he is."
quoted.T2:3:0: "The flat's where I sleep now, and the plot's where I live. That's how it feels. I wake up and the first thing I think is, I wonder if the onions are all right. Not, what am I going to do with myself."
quoted.T2:17:0: "But you can't fix a bean. … And when Maureen laughed, it went out of me, the embarrassment. … It wasn't me. It was the year."
